create_sentence_encoder: create a SentenceEncoder instance with a default or custom Transformer for RoBERTa inference
load_roberta_weights: load public RoBERTa weights into a SentenceEncoder using load_roberta_state_dict
translate_roberta_state_dict: translate a public RoBERTa state dict to match the SentenceEncoder key structure
merge_input_projection: merge split q, k, v projection weights back into in_proj_weight and in_proj_bias
rename_state_keys: rename state dict keys matching a regex pattern with a replacement string
